paper_record.title: Polaritonic self-hybridized critical coupling by Brillouin zone folding induced quasi-bound states in the continuum in bulk WS2 metasurfaces
paper_record.abstract: Maximizing the absorption of exciton-polaritons in transition-metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs) under critical coupling conditions is crucial for developing high-efficiency polariton-based photodetectors, solar cells, and perfect absorbers. Here, we propose a polaritonic critical self-hybridized coupling between Brillouin zone folding driven quasi-bound states in the continuum (BZF-QBIC) mode and A excitons in a bulk WS2 metasurface. This polaritonic critical coupling shows robust behavior with respect to the asymmetric parameters of the involved BZF-QBIC mode, in contrast to the asymmetry-sensitive conventional QBIC-based critical coupling. By changing the height of WS2 metasurfaces, we observe a typical anti-crossing behavior with a Rabi splitting of 246.5 meV. Moreover, the maximum absorption value of 0.5 for exciton-polaritons is achieved at the polaritonic critical coupling condition. The large population of excitons provided by bulk WS2 is essential for achieving polaritonic critical coupling and can further enhance polaritonic absorption. This work enables the realization of robust, high-absorption self-hybridized polaritonic critical coupling in TMDCs, and further expedite their applications in high-absorption low-dimensional polaritonic devices.

one_sentence_summary.zh: 本文提出并验证了体相 WS2 超表面中布里渊区折叠准连续束缚态与激子之间的自杂化强临界耦合，实现了鲁棒的高极化激子吸收增强。
one_sentence_summary.en: This paper proposes and demonstrates self-hybridized strong critical coupling between Brillouin zone folding-induced quasi-bound states in the continuum and excitons in bulk WS2 metasurfaces, achieving robust polaritonic absorption enhancement.

problem.zh: 传统的基于对称保护准连续束缚态（QBIC）的极化激子临界耦合对不对称参数非常敏感，参数调节会引起共振波长漂移，从而阻碍了鲁棒强耦合的实现。
problem.en: Conventional polaritonic critical coupling based on symmetry-protected quasi-bound states in the continuum is sensitive to asymmetric parameters, where tuning parameters shifts the resonant wavelength and hinders robust strong coupling.

approach.zh: 利用体相 WS2 超表面的布里渊区折叠机制引入准连续束缚态（BZF-QBIC），通过有限元仿真结合耦合模理论与 Fano 公式拟合，研究了其光学与耦合特性。
approach.en: Utilizing Brillouin zone folding-induced quasi-bound states in the continuum (BZF-QBIC) in bulk WS2 metasurfaces, the optical and coupling properties are investigated using finite element method simulations combined with coupled-mode theory and Fano fitting.

main_takeaway.zh: 该体相 WS2 超表面系统实现了 246.5 meV 的拉比分裂和自杂化强临界耦合，在临界耦合条件下极化激子吸收率达到了 0.5 的理论最大值，且对不对称参数的变化表现出鲁棒性。
main_takeaway.en: The bulk WS2 metasurface system achieves a Rabi splitting of 246.5 meV and self-hybridized strong critical coupling, reaching the theoretical maximum polariton absorption of 0.5 at critical coupling with robust behavior against asymmetry parameters.

why_it_matters.zh: 该研究为实现低维半导体中鲁棒、高效的极化激子器件（如光电探测器和太阳能电池）提供了一种通用的强临界耦合策略。
why_it_matters.en: This work provides a general strategy for realizing robust and high-efficiency polaritonic devices, such as photodetectors and solar cells, based on low-dimensional semiconductors.

reason.zh: 该工作在体相过渡金属二硫属化物中实现了自杂化强临界耦合与高吸收，克服了传统 QBIC 调谐对波长的敏感性限制，对高性能极化激子器件的发展具有重要推动作用。
reason.en: The work achieves self-hybridized strong critical coupling and high absorption in bulk transition-metal dichalcogenides, overcoming traditional QBIC wavelength-tuning limitations and advancing high-performance polaritonic devices.

reason.zh: 该期刊广泛发表关于纳米光子学、超表面、光学微腔以及强光与物质相互作用的高质量研究工作。
reason.en: The journal broadly publishes high-quality research on nanophotonics, metasurfaces, optical microcavities, and strong light-matter interactions.
